meaning: Blocked filter: food particles have clogged the dishwasher filter, which needs cleaning regularly.
causes: Food particles and debris in the filter
diySteps: Remove the filter and wash it under running water with mild soap and a soft brush to remove debris
Reinstall the filter (see your owner's manual for the full instructions)
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If E22 returns after cleaning the filter, check Bosch's E22 guide or contact Bosch Customer Support.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
